title: Towards bridging the gap: Systematic sim-to-real transfer for diverse legged robots

blocks.en: Filip Bjelonic1 , Fabian Tischhauser1 and Marco Hutter1
blocks.zh: Filip Bjelonic1, Fabian Tischhauser1 和 Marco Hutter1

blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Legged robots must achieve both robust locomotion and energy efficiency to be practical in real-world environments. Yet controllers trained in simulation often fail to transfer reliably, and most existing approaches neglect actuator-specific energy losses or depend on complex, hand-tuned reward formulations.
blocks.zh: 足式机器人必须兼顾稳健运动与能量效率，才能在现实环境中具备实用性。然而，在仿真中训练的控制器往往无法可靠迁移，且大多数现有方法要么忽略了执行器特有的能量损耗，要么依赖复杂的手动调优奖励函数形式。

blocks.en: We propose a framework that integrates sim-to-real reinforcement learning with a physics-grounded energy model for permanent magnet synchronous motors. The framework requires a minimal parameter set to capture the simulation–reality gap and employs a compact four-term reward with a first-principle-based energetic loss formulation that balances electrical and mechanical dissipation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个将仿真到现实强化学习与基于物理机理的永磁同步电机（PMSM）能量模型相结合的框架。该框架仅需极小参数集即可表征仿真与现实之间的差距，并采用包含四个紧凑奖励项的奖励函数，结合基于第一性原理的能量损耗表述来平衡电学与机械耗散。

blocks.en: We evaluate and validate the approach through a bottom-up dynamic parameter identification study, spanning actuators, full-robot in-air trajectories and on-ground locomotion. The framework is tested on three primary platforms and deployed on ten additional robots, demonstrating reliable policy transfer without randomization of dynamic parameters. Our method improves the energetic efficiency over state-of-the-art methods, achieving a 32 % reduction in the full Cost of Transport of ANYMAL (1 . 27). All code, models, and datasets will be released.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一项自底向上的动力学参数辨识研究对该方法进行评估与验证，涵盖执行器、整机空中轨迹以及地面运动。该框架在三大主要平台上进行了测试，并部署于另外十台机器人上，证明了无需对动力学参数进行随机化即可实现可靠的策略迁移。与现有最先进方法相比，我们的方法提高了能量效率，使 ANYMAL 的整机运输成本（Cost of Transport, 1 . 27）降低了 32 %。所有代码、模型和数据集都将开源发布。

blocks.en: Keywords
blocks.zh: 关键词

blocks.en: Legged robots, Quadrupedal locomotion, Reinforcement learning, Simulation-to-real transfer, Reality gap, Energy efficiency
blocks.zh: 足式机器人，四足运动，强化学习，仿真到现实迁移，现实差距，能量效率

blocks.en: Legged robots promise versatile mobility in environments that are inaccessible to wheeled or tracked platforms. However, achieving robust and efficient locomotion remains a central challenge: Controllers trained in simulation only show the same performance on the real system if the system and actuator dynamics are accurately modeled. Modeling errors, in particular in the actuator dynamics, where electrical and mechanical losses are often not properly modeled, lead to major inefficiencies and hence directly affect robot endurance and payload capacity.
blocks.zh: 足式机器人有望在轮式或履带式平台无法通行的环境中实现多功能机动性。然而，实现稳健且高效的运动仍是一项核心挑战：在仿真中训练的控制器，唯有在系统与执行器动力学均被精确建模的情况下，才能在真实系统上表现出相同性能。建模误差——尤其是在通常未能对电学和机械损耗进行适当建模的执行器动力学中——会导致严重的效率低下，进而直接影响机器人的续航能力与负载能力。

blocks.en: Prior work has addressed the simulation-to-reality gap through extensive domain randomization, residual modeling, or full physics identification. While these methods have demonstrated impressive sim-to-real transfer, they often require specialized sensors, exhaustive parameter identification, or iterative expert tuning of heuristic models and reward functions. As a result, current RL controller pipelines often rely on complex, high-dimensional reward functions. As modeling errors increase the sim-to-real gap, environment design often resorts to repeatedly adjusting rewards based on observed discrepancies in the real system—an ad-hoc process that can be repeated many times without clear structure, and which further disconnects rewards from physical notions such as efficiency.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作通过广泛的域随机化、残差建模或全物理辨识来解决仿真到现实的差距。尽管这些方法展示出了令人瞩目的仿真到现实迁移效果，但它们往往需要专用传感器、详尽的参数辨识，或者专家对启发式模型与奖励函数的反复迭代调优。因此，当前的强化学习（RL）控制器管线往往依赖于复杂的高维奖励函数。随着建模误差加剧了仿真到现实的差距，环境设计往往不得不根据在真实系统上观察到的差异反复调整奖励——这是一种缺乏清晰结构、可被多次重复的权宜之计（ad-hoc 过程），并使得奖励进一步与诸如效率等物理概念脱节。

blocks.en: This work introduces a framework that addresses these challenges by combining a sim-to-real RL pipeline with systematic actuator modeling. We perform a bottom-up analysis: first characterizing single actuator models, then estimating dynamic parameters on the full-system level, and finally validating locomotion control across multiple platforms. A focus of our framework is the integration of a physics-grounded energy model for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSMs), which enables training of locomotion policies that are both transferable and energyefficient.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了一个通过将仿真到现实强化学习管线与系统化执行器建模相结合来应对这些挑战的框架。我们进行了一项自底向上的分析：首先对单个执行器模型进行表征，然后在整机系统层级估计动力学参数，最后在多个平台上验证运动控制。我们框架的一个重点是集成了基于物理机理的永磁同步电机（PMSM）能量模型，从而能够训练出兼具可迁移性与能量效率的运动策略。

blocks.en: 1 Related Work
blocks.zh: 1 相关工作

blocks.en: Our manuscript focuses on state-of-the-art methods for rigid robots actuated by Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSMs), which are the dominant choice in modern legged robots due to their efficiency and controllability (see Figure 2 for a few prominent examples ( 1–5 )). For clarity, we note that while “Brushless Direct Current Motor (BLDC)” is often used in industry as a generic label for brushless motors, it formally refers to machines with trapezoidal back-EMF driven by six-step commutation, whereas most legged robots employ sinusoidal PMSMs with field-oriented control ( 6, 7 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的论文侧重于针对由永磁同步电机（PMSM）驱动的刚性机器人的最先进方法，由于其高效率和良好可控性，PMSM 是现代足式机器人的主流选择（若干突出示例见图 2 ( 1–5 )）。为明确起见，我们指出：尽管“无刷直流电机（BLDC）”在工业界常被用作无刷电机的统称，但严格来说，它指的是具有梯形反电动势并通过六步换相驱动的电机；而大多数足式机器人则采用配合磁场定向控制的正弦波 PMSM ( 6, 7 )。

blocks.en: 1.1 Modeling
blocks.zh: 1.1 建模

blocks.en: Modeling approaches for sim-to-real transfer can be broadly categorized by the trade-off between physical prior knowledge and the amount of real-world data required. At one end, simplified physics models and domain randomization require little real-world data but assume accurate rigid-body dynamics. Residual physics approaches combine moderate priors with learned corrections, needing additional data to capture unmodeled effects. At the other end, full dynamics models minimize assumptions but demand extensive real-world interaction to learn complete system dynamics. Both model-based and purely data-driven approaches are represented across this spectrum.
blocks.zh: 用于仿真到现实迁移的建模方法，大致可以根据物理先验知识与所需真实世界数据量之间的权衡进行分类。在谱系的一端，简化的物理模型和域随机化所需真实世界数据极少，但假定具有精确的刚体动力学。残差物理方法将适度的先验与学习到的修正相结合，需要额外的数据来捕获未建模效应。在谱系的另一端，全动力学模型尽可能减少假设，但需要大量的真实世界交互来学习完整的系统动力学。基于模型的方法和纯数据驱动的方法均分布在这一谱系之中。

blocks.en: Low-data approaches. These methods rely mostly on rigid-body dynamics from the robot description. Cassie SysID combined with domain randomization ( 8 ), handcalibrated parameters with randomized variations ( 9 ), and classical dynamics randomization for reinforcement learning ( 10 ) or imitation learning ( 11 ) fall into this category. Large-scale randomization has been shown effective for dexterous manipulation (DexTreme ( 12 )). Variants include active domain randomization ( 13 ), probabilistic approaches such as BayesSim ( 14 ), adversarial domain randomization ( 15 ), and methods like DROPO ( 16 ).
blocks.zh: 低数据量方法。这些方法主要依赖于由机器人描述文件提供的刚体动力学。Cassie SysID 结合域随机化 ( 8 )、手动标定参数配合随机变动 ( 9 )，以及用于强化学习 ( 10 ) 或模仿学习 ( 11 ) 的经典动力学随机化，均属于此类。大规模随机化已被证明对灵巧操作有效（DexTreme ( 12 )）。其变体包括主动域随机化 ( 13 )、诸如 BayesSim ( 14 ) 等概率方法、对抗域随机化 ( 15 ) 以及 DROPO ( 16 ) 等方法。

blocks.en: Moderate-data approaches. Residual models combine physics priors with learned corrections, often focusing on actuator or body-level dynamics. Neural augmentations of simulators capture uncertainties ( 17 ), while adversarial techniques such as SimGAN identify simulation parameters ( 18 ).
blocks.zh: 中等数据量方法。残差模型将物理先验与学习到的修正项相结合，通常聚焦于执行器或本体层级的动力学。对仿真器的神经网络增强能够捕获不确定性 ( 17 )，而诸如 SimGAN 等对抗技术则用于辨识仿真参数 ( 18 )。

blocks.en: Neural-Augmented Simulation (NAS) introduces recurrent residual dynamics ( 19 ). Joint-centric methods include actuator networks that leverage joint torque sensors ( 20 ), unsupervised actuator models without torque sensing ( 21 ), drivelimit estimations on SPOT ( 22 ), and delta-action models through real-world rollouts (ASAP ( 23 )). Body-centric methods aim to identify physical parameters at the system level, for instance via sampling-based active exploration (SPIActive ( 24 )) or learning discrepancies from human demonstrations (DROID ( 25 )). Hybrid strategies combine low-level SysID with residual dynamics models, such as aerodynamic compensation for the floating robot BALLU ( 26 ).
blocks.zh: 神经增强仿真（NAS）引入了循环残差动力学 ( 19 )。以关节为中心的方法包括利用关节扭矩传感器的执行器网络 ( 20 )、无扭矩传感的无监督执行器模型 ( 21 )、针对 SPOT 的驱动极限估计 ( 22 )，以及通过真实世界 rollout 构建的增量动作（delta-action）模型（ASAP ( 23 )）。以本体为中心的方法旨在系统层级辨识物理参数，例如通过基于采样的自主探索（SPIActive ( 24 )）或从人类演示中学习差异（DROID ( 25 )）。混合策略则将低层级系统辨识（SysID）与残差动力学模型相结合，例如针对漂浮机器人 BALLU 的气动力补偿 ( 26 )。

blocks.en: High-data approaches. Full dynamics-based methods attempt to learn the complete robot dynamics with little or no reliance on physical priors. DayDreamer ( 27 ) learns world models from scratch, updating them through realworld rollouts while replaying the best policy. Offline world models similarly combine simulation-initialized dynamics with real-world fine-tuning ( 28 ). Other approaches estimate grounded forward and inverse dynamics transformations ( 29 ) to enhance simulator accuracy.
blocks.zh: 高数据量方法。基于全动力学的方法试图在极少或完全不依赖物理先验的情况下学习完整的机器人动力学。DayDreamer ( 27 ) 从零开始学习世界模型，在回放最优策略的同时通过真实世界 rollout 来更新世界模型。离线世界模型同样将仿真初始化的动力学与真实世界的微调相结合 ( 28 )。另有其他方法估计基于物理现实的正向与逆向动力学变换 ( 29 )，以提升仿真器的精度。

blocks.en: Online adaptation. To cope with discrepancies that remain during deployment, online adaptation mechanisms are employed. Strategies include online fine-tuning ( 30 ), meta-learning for rapid adaptation ( 31 ), and student–teacher schemes for online parameter identification ( 32 ).
blocks.zh: 在线自适应。为了应对部署期间残留的差异，常采用在线自适应机制。相关策略包括在线微调 ( 30 )、用于快速自适应的元学习 ( 31 )，以及用于在线参数辨识的学生-教师方案 ( 32 )。

blocks.en: For comprehensive surveys on sim-to-real, see Muratore et al. ( 33 ) or Ju et al. ( 34 ).
blocks.zh: 关于仿真到现实迁移的全面综述，参见 Muratore 等人 ( 33 ) 或 Ju 等人 ( 34 )。

blocks.en: While prior work has successfully employed domain randomization ( 8, 12 ) or residual dynamics ( 20, 21 ), these approaches often require specialized sensors or exhaustive parameter searches. Our method instead introduces a minimal set of parameters that compactly capture the simulation–reality gap, placing it within the class of moderate-data approaches. We further show that actuator drive dynamics are largely linear ( q ˆ → q ), which enables fast optimization of a concise and physically interpretable parameter set that transfers across platforms.
blocks.zh: 虽然先前的工作成功采用了域随机化 ( 8, 12 ) 或残差动力学 ( 20, 21 )，但这些方法通常需要专用传感器或详尽的参数搜索。相比之下，我们的方法引入了一组能够紧凑表征仿真与现实差距的极小参数集，使其归属于中等数据量方法类别。我们进一步表明执行器驱动动力学基本呈线性 ( q ˆ → q )，从而能够快速优化出一组简洁且具备物理可解释性、可跨平台迁移的参数集。

blocks.en: 1.2 Control
blocks.zh: 1.2 控制

blocks.en: Control of legged robots in complex terrain has been approached with both Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) ( 35–38 ). Current stateof-the-art emphasizes RL, often based on Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) ( 39 ) and its constrained derivatives, such as IPO ( 40 ) or TRPO-based formulations for locomotion ( 41 ).
blocks.zh: 在复杂地形中对足式机器人的控制，已有模型预测控制（MPC）和强化学习（RL）两种途径 ( 35–38 )。当前最先进的技术侧重于 RL，通常基于近端策略优化（PPO）( 39 ) 及其受约束的衍生方法，例如用于运动控制的 IPO ( 40 ) 或基于 TRPO 的形式表达 ( 41 )。

blocks.en: Partial observability. Real-world control is inherently a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP). Compared to fully observable MDPs, learning under partial observability is more challenging, as policies must cope with state aliasing and incomplete information ( 42 ). In practice, standard RL methods often exhibit degraded performance or unstable training when policies are restricted
blocks.zh: 部分可观测性。真实世界的控制在本质上是一个部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）。与完全可观测的 MDP 相比，在部分可观测条件下学习更具挑战性，因为策略必须应对状态混叠与不完整信息 ( 42 )。在实践中，当策略受到限制

blocks.en: to partial observations ( 43, 44 ). Several strategies have been proposed to mitigate these challenges, including large-scale parallelized RL training ( 45 ), teacher–student distillation ( 32 ), and asymmetric actor–critic architectures where the critic has privileged state access ( 44 ).
blocks.zh: 仅能获得部分观测时 ( 43, 44 )，标准强化学习方法往往表现出性能退化或训练不稳定。为此已提出若干策略来缓解这些挑战，包括大规模并行化强化学习训练 ( 45 )、教师-学生蒸馏 ( 32 )，以及 Critic 具有特权状态访问权限的非对称 Actor-Critic 架构 ( 44 )。

blocks.en: Reward design. Reward shaping is a central challenge, as locomotion policies often involve more than ten hand-crafted reward terms ( 32, 36, 46, 47 ), making tuning difficult and requiring expert heuristics. Constraint-based formulations can reduce the dimensionality of reward terms ( 41 ), but in practice, they shift part of the tuning complexity to the choice and scaling of constraints. Multi-morphology training similarly offloads tuning to central pattern generators ( 48 ). Other approaches attempt to automate reward design with large language models (Eureka ( 49 )) or remove explicit rewards altogether by optimizing intrinsic objectives, such as DIAYN ( 50 ).
blocks.zh: 奖励设计。奖励塑形是一项核心挑战，因为运动策略通常涉及十多个手工设计的奖励项 ( 32, 36, 46, 47 )，导致调参困难且需要专家的启发式经验。基于约束的形式化表述可以降低奖励项的维度 ( 41 )，但在实践中，这会将部分调参复杂度转移到约束的选择与缩放尺度上。多形态训练同样将调参负担转嫁给中枢模式发生器 ( 48 )。其他方法则尝试利用大语言模型实现奖励设计的自动化（Eureka ( 49 )），或者通过优化内在目标完全摒弃显式奖励，例如 DIAYN ( 50 )。

blocks.en: Most recent controllers ( 36, 45 ) achieve agility, relying on high-dimensional and ad hoc reward shaping. We instead formulate rewards directly from actuator energy losses, yielding a compact and physically meaningful objective. Our formulation only requires four reward terms, which reduces tuning complexity.
blocks.zh: 近期大多数控制器 ( 36, 45 ) 虽实现了敏捷性，但都依赖于高维且专门针对性的奖励塑形。与之不同，我们直接根据执行器能量损耗来构建奖励，从而得到了一个紧凑且具有物理意义的目标。我们的公式化表述仅需要四个奖励项，从而降低了调参复杂度。

blocks.en: 1.3 Energy-efficient locomotion
blocks.zh: 1.3 高能效运动

blocks.en: Energy-efficient control is critical for autonomous legged robots. Total losses consist of controller-independent terms such as sensing, computation, and inverter switching, and motion- respectively control-policy-dependent losses, which can be optimized. The literature on modeling motion-dependent energy losses can be grouped into pseudo-approximations, low-fidelity models, and highfidelity models.
blocks.zh: 高能效控制对于自主足式机器人至关重要。总损耗由与控制器无关的项（如传感、计算和逆变器开关损耗）以及分别取决于运动与控制策略的损耗构成，后者是可以被优化的。关于对运动相关能量损耗进行建模的文献可以分为伪近似方法、低保真度模型和高保真度模型。

blocks.en: Pseudo-approximations. Simplified proxies such as squared torque are frequently used to approximate energy costs. However, many works omit mechanical power consumption altogether ( 32, 36, 41, 46, 47 ), or introduce objectives with weak correlation to actual energy, e.g., penalizing changes in power ( 48 ).
blocks.zh: 伪近似方法。诸如力矩平方等简化代理量常被用来近似能耗成本。然而，许多工作完全忽略了机械功率损耗 ( 32, 36, 41, 46, 47 )，或者引入了与实际能量相关性较弱的目标，例如惩罚功率的变化 ( 48 )。

blocks.en: Low-fidelity models. These methods typically split energy into mechanical power and Joule heating ( 51 ). Scaling between these terms is often hand-tuned or derived from motor characteristics ( 52, 53 ), enabling training of energyaware locomotion controllers ( 3, 54 ).
blocks.zh: 低保真度模型。这些方法通常将能量划分为机械功率和焦耳热 ( 51 )。这两项之间的比例权重通常通过人工调优或根据电机特性推导得出 ( 52, 53 )，从而支持训练具有能量感知能力的运动控制器 ( 3, 54 )。

blocks.en: High-fidelity models. Advanced approaches numerically compute individual loss components, including copper losses ( P Cu), iron losses ( P FE), permanent magnet losses ( P PM), and mechanical dissipation ( 55 ). Recent data-driven work has employed accurate power measurement to train neural networks that predict instantaneous power consumption in legged robots ( 56 ).
blocks.zh: 高保真度模型。更先进的方法通过数值方法计算各个独立的损耗分量，包括铜损 ( P Cu )、铁损 ( P FE )、永磁体损耗 ( P PM ) 以及机械耗散 ( 55 )。近期的数据驱动研究则利用精确的功率测量来训练神经网络，从而预测足式机器人的瞬时功耗 ( 56 )。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: Our pipeline to bridge the reality gap comprises three stages, illustrated in Figure 3. (i) Data collection on the real robot (Section 2.1), using joint impedance (PD) control to execute and record trajectories. (ii) Simulator alignment via evolutionary parameter identification (Section 2.2), where we fit a compact set of parameters so that simulated in-air trajectories match the recorded ones. (iii) Policy learning and deployment (Section 2.3), where we train a blind locomotion controller and deploy it zero-shot on hardware. We refer to the overall approach as Precise Adaptation through Continuous Evolution (PACE).
blocks.zh: 我们用于弥合现实差距的流程包含三个阶段，如图 3 所示：(i) 真实机器人上的数据采集（第 2.1 节），利用关节阻抗（PD）控制来执行并记录轨迹；(ii) 通过演化参数辨识进行仿真器对齐（第 2.2 节），拟合一组紧凑的参数，使仿真中的空中轨迹与记录的实际轨迹相吻合；(iii) 策略学习与部署（第 2.3 节），在仿真中训练盲走运动控制器并将其零样本部署到硬件上。我们将该整体方法称为通过连续演化的精确自适应（Precise Adaptation through Continuous Evolution，PACE）。

blocks.en: 2.1 Data collection
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据采集

blocks.en: Data collection is conducted with a fixed base to avoid motion cross-coupling between different limbs. We excite all joints simultaneously using chirp signals of 20 – 60 s per sequence, sweeping from a minimum to a maximum frequency. Signals and measurements are time-synchronized and logged at high sampling rates (typically 400 – 10 000 Hz). We found the following conditions to work best.
blocks.zh: 数据采集是在固定基座的条件下进行的，以避免不同肢体之间的运动交叉耦合。我们使用每个序列时长为 20 – 60 s 的线性调频（chirp）信号同时激励所有关节，频率从最低扫至最高。信号和测量数据保持时间同步，并以高采样率（通常为 400 – 10 000 Hz）进行记录。我们发现以下实验条件效果最佳。

blocks.en: Fixed base (no base motion) During simulation replay we rigidly fix the base in air. For robots with symmetry planes (e.g., two for ANYMAL/MINIMAL, one for TYTAN), we cancel net base wrenches by commanding symmetric joint trajectories.
blocks.zh: 固定基座（无基座运动）。在仿真重放期间，我们将基座刚性固定在空中。对于具有对称面的机器人（例如 ANYMAL/MINIMAL 具有两个对称面，TYTAN 具有一个对称面），我们通过发送对称的关节轨迹指令来抵消基座承受的合力与合力矩（net base wrenches）。

blocks.en: No contacts (legs free in air). We avoid all contacts (including inter-leg) so the identification is not confounded by unmeasured external forces. Moreover, in stance the base inertia dominates the effective joint dynamics; collecting inair data isolates leg/drive dynamics. A simplified model in Appendix B shows that in agile stance the effective base inertia exceeds leg/drive inertias by 1–2 orders of magnitude (ANYMAL example).
blocks.zh: 无接触（腿部悬空）。我们避免所有接触（包括腿间接触），从而使参数辨识不受未测外力的干扰。此外，在支撑相时，基座惯量主导了有效关节动力学；而采集空中悬空数据可以单独隔离出腿部及驱动系统的动力学。附录 B 中的简化模型表明，在敏捷支撑相下，有效基座惯量比腿部/驱动惯量高出 1–2 个数量级（以 ANYMAL 为例）。

blocks.en: Excitation bandwidth. Ideally, trajectories cover up to f policy / 2 (Nyquist of the control policy), since this is the highest possible frequency that the controller can excite in the system. Structural constraints may limit this (e.g., 2 Hz on ANYMAL; 10 Hz on TYTAN/MINIMAL). If structural or practical constraints prevent reaching this range, the excitation should at least cover twice the highest frequency expected in the locomotion controller’s motion (e.g., 1 Hz for our robots walking at 1 m s−1 ).
blocks.zh: 激励带宽。理想情况下，轨迹频率应覆盖至 f policy / 2（控制策略的奈奎斯特频率），因为这是控制器能在系统中激励出的最高频率。结构约束可能会对此有所限制（例如 ANYMAL 上为 2 Hz；TYTAN/MINIMAL 上为 10 Hz）。如果结构或实际限制阻碍了达到该范围，则激励至少应覆盖运动控制器动作中预期最高频率的两倍（例如，我们的机器人以 1 m s−1 行走时预期频率为 1 Hz）。

We therefore use small gains in simulation for both identification and policy training—so that the characteristic dynamics (poles) appear at lower frequencies.

blocks.en: 2.3 Learning environment
blocks.zh: 2.3 学习环境

blocks.en: Having addressed simulator alignment through parameter identification, we now turn to the learning-based control stage. Because PACE identifies the dynamics end-to-end, we do not use dynamics randomization. We randomize the task (pushes, ground friction) and terrains (flat/rough, stairs, boxes, slopes). We otherwise follow standard practice ( 45 ), emphasizing only differences below.
blocks.zh: 在通过参数辨识完成仿真器对齐后，我们现在转向基于学习的控制阶段。由于 PACE 端到端地辨识动力学，我们不使用动力学随机化。我们对任务（推力扰动、地面摩擦）以及地形（平坦/崎岖、楼梯、箱体、斜坡）进行随机化。在其他方面我们遵循标准做法 ( 45 )，下文仅强调不同之处。

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 实验

blocks.en: This section introduces the robotic platforms and the experimental protocols. We evaluate PACE in two stages. First, controlled in-air validation and evaluation experiments (Section 3.2) establish methodological soundness at different levels of system complexity, ranging from a single drive to the fully suspended robot. Second, on-ground locomotion experiments (Section 3.3) apply the approach in realistic deployment scenarios, assessing performance and energetic efficiency.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍机器人平台与实验方案。我们分两个阶段对 PACE 进行评估。首先，受控的空中验证与评估实验（第 3.2 节）在从单个驱动器到完全悬挂机器人的不同系统复杂度层级上，确立了方法的合理性。其次，地面运动实验（第 3.3 节）将该方法应用于实际部署场景，评估其运动性能与能量效率。

blocks.en: We proceed bottom–up: (In–air: i) single–actuator analysis on TYTAN (full access to firmware, electronics, and mechanics, Section 3.2.1); (In–air: ii) full–robot identification and validation, including a comparison on ANYMAL against a zero–model baseline and a state-of-the-art actuator network ( 20 ) (Section 3.2.2); (On–ground: iii) full–robot locomotion experiments (Sections 3.3.1 3.3.2) under the same conditions as (In–air: ii) and (On–ground: iv) longduration energetic evaluations (Section 3.3.3).
blocks.zh: 我们采取自底向上的路线：（空中：i）在 TYTAN 上进行单执行器分析（可完全访问固件、电路与机械系统，第 3.2.1 节）；（空中：ii）整机辨识与验证，包括在 ANYMAL 上与零模型基线及前沿执行器网络 ( 20 ) 的对比（第 3.2.2 节）；（地面：iii）在与（空中：ii）相同条件下进行的整机运动实验（第 3.3.1 与 3.3.2 节），以及（地面：iv）长时间能量消耗评估（第 3.3.3 节）。

blocks.en: Each experimental stage has a distinct objective. The single–drive study validates high-bandwidth motor torque tracking and mechanical identification under fully known conditions. The in-air full–robot experiments test whether the approach scales to system level, generalizes across PD gains and trajectories, and allow benchmarking against a zero–model baseline and a learned actuator network ( 20 ). Finally, the on–ground locomotion trials demonstrate the practical applicability of PACE, evaluating tracking accuracy, energetic efficiency, and long–duration performance.
blocks.zh: 每个实验阶段都有明确的目标。单驱动器研究验证了在完全已知条件下的高带宽电机力矩跟踪与机械辨识。空中整机实验测试了该方法能否扩展到系统级、能否在不同 PD 增益和轨迹之间泛化，并能够与零模型基线以及基于学习的执行器网络 ( 20 ) 进行对比基准测试。最后，地面运动试验展示了 PACE 的实际适用性，评估了其跟踪精度、能量效率以及长时运行性能。

blocks.en: 3.1 Robots
blocks.zh: 3.1 机器人

blocks.en: We perform analysis on three quadrupeds—TYTAN, ANYMAL, and MINIMAL—chosen to span actuation types, scales, and transparency (open vs. closed source). All three share the same leg topology: Hip Abduction–Adduction (HAA), Hip Flexion–Extension (HFE), and Knee Flexion–Extension (KFE), with point feet (rubber end caps). All joints are PMSM driven. Key characteristics are summarized in Table 1 with “?” marks indicate confidential specifications we are not permitted to disclose.
blocks.zh: 我们对三款四足机器人——TYTAN、ANYMAL 和 MINIMAL——进行了分析，选择它们是为了涵盖不同的驱动类型、尺度以及系统透明度（开源对比闭源）。三者具有相同的腿部拓扑结构：髋关节外展/内收（HAA）、髋关节屈曲/伸展（HFE）和膝关节屈曲/伸展（KFE），并配备点足（橡胶端盖）。所有关节均由永磁同步电机（PMSM）驱动。主要特征汇总于表 1，其中“?”标记表示不允许公开的保密规格。

blocks.en: TYTAN —a custom platform developed at ETH Zurich and based on BARRY ( 61 )—uses pseudo-direct drives at HAA/HFE (fixed ratio r =5 . 6) and a variable-ratio ball-screw lever at KFE ( r ∈ [0 . 8 , 9]). It employs a low inertia leg design by moving the knee-motor towards its hip.
blocks.zh: TYTAN 是苏黎世联邦理工学院（ETH Zurich）基于 BARRY ( 61 ) 开发的定制平台，在 HAA/HFE 处采用准直接驱动（固定传动比 r = 5 . 6），在 KFE 处采用可变传动比滚珠丝杠连杆机构（r ∈ [0 . 8 , 9]）。它通过将膝部电机移向髋部，实现了低惯量的腿部设计。

blocks.en: MINIMAL is a small, largely 3D-printed quadruped. All joints share a variable-ratio lever mechanism driven by T- Motor units and a lead-screw transmission. In total 76 % of its total mass is situated in the base with only 6 % at each leg.
blocks.zh: MINIMAL 是一款小型、主要由 3D 打印构成的四足机器人。其所有关节均采用由 T-Motor 单元和丝杠传动驱动的可变传动比杠杆机构。其总质量的 76 % 集中在基座上，每条腿仅占 6 %。

blocks.en: Beyond these three primary platforms, PACE has also been deployed on a diverse set of robots, including AIBO ( 63 ), NAO, ALMA ( 64, 65 ), SPACEHOPPER ( 66 ), LEVA ( 67 ), MAGNECKO v1 ( 68 )/v2, GR-1 ( 69 ), the ALLEGRO Hand, and the ABILITY Hand (see Fig. 4), as well as additional unpublished systems not shown here.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Data collection On each system, we record multijoint chirps with varying amplitudes. Typical sequence duration is 20 – 40 s with f 0 = 0 . 1 Hz and a maximum frequency of 10 Hz to avoid excessive actuator stress. Structural constraints limit the achievable bandwidth on suspended setups (full TYTAN: 8 Hz; ANYMAL: 2 Hz; cf. Section 2.1).

blocks.en: The following experiments validate PACE under controlled, contact-free conditions. The single-drive setup isolates mechanical effects and directly reveals the physical meaning of the identified inertia Ia and damping d . blocks.en: 3.2.2 Full robot At the system level we identify all parameters, including joint position biases and a global delay, with the base stationary and legs moving in air. We collect identification and validation sets on TYTAN, ANYMAL, and MINIMAL. For TYTAN, identification uses sinusoidal joint targets at Pτ =60 N m rad−1 , Dτ = 2 N m s rad−1 ; validation repeats with Pτ =145 N m rad−1 , Dτ =5 N m s rad−1 . For MINIMAL, we additionally validate on random joint steps (0 . 5 s dwell). On ANYMAL, lowlevel gains are fixed; we therefore use the vendor defaults (matching the actuator-network training setup). blocks.en: 3.3 On-ground locomotion analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 着地运动分析

blocks.en: Having validated PACE under controlled conditions, we now assess its performance in locomotion scenarios under ground contact. These experiments evaluate full-robot deployment on hardware, testing whether the identified models enable robust tracking. We further analyze the two platforms TYTAN and ANYMAL on long-duration trials. We quantify locomotion efficiency and decompose the total energy consumption into contributions from locomotion, inverter switching losses, compute and sensors overhead.
blocks.zh: 在受控条件下验证了 PACE 之后，我们现在评估其在地面接触运动场景中的性能。这些实验评估了真机硬件上的整机部署，测试辨识出的模型能否实现鲁棒跟踪。我们进一步在长时间试验中对 TYTAN 和 ANYMAL 两个平台进行了分析。我们对运动能效进行了量化，并将总能耗分解为运动做功、逆变器开关损耗、计算与传感开销各部分的贡献。

blocks.en: Using the identified parameters, we train blind locomotion policies as in Section 2.3 without dynamics randomization. Hyperparameters and robot specific parameters are listed in Table 7 and Table 2 respectively.

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Tytan We train a single policy and compare real vs. simulation by replaying the real commanded base-velocity trajectory in open loop. The robot is manually driven within a 3 m × 3 m area; total duration is ∼ 90 s (SignalLogger buffer limit).

仅使用 URDF 时前向行走失败（被安全吊索保护捕获），而执行器网络和 PACE 均成功运行（Figure 7）。在稳态期间，两者均实现了约 ≈ 0 . 85 m s−1 的平均速度（小提琴图），并具有相似的极限环；无模型情况在 ∼ 3 s 内即发生发散。附录中提供了横向与偏航测试（Figure 21）；仅 URDF 策略可以执行 2 rad s−1 的偏航阶跃，但在 1 m s−1 的前向与横向行走中依然不可靠。

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Energetic running-track evaluations We replicate the 400 m track protocol of Bjelonic et al. ( 71 ) and extend it with ANYMAL D and TYTAN. Summary statistics are listed in Table 3. State-of-charge vs. distance, CoT decomposition, frequency spectra, and a knee limit-cycle analysis are in Figure 8.

4.2.3 跑道能效评估
我们复现了 Bjelonic 等人（71）的 400 m 跑道实验方案，并扩展到了 ANYMAL D 与 TYTAN 上。汇总统计数据列于 Table 3。荷电状态随距离的变化曲线、CoT 分解、频谱分析以及膝关节极限环分析见 Figure 8。

blocks.en: We decompose the cost of transport (CoT) into electronics (CoE), drives (CoD), and locomotion (CoL) using the procedures in Section 3.3.3. Table 4 summarizes the contributions. For ANYMAL D, Cost of Transport (CoT) reduces to 1 . 27 (vs. 1 . 86 for ANYMAL C); TYTAN reaches 0 . 97. In both platforms, less than half of the energy is attributed to CoL. Biological dogs reach similar distribution at half the CoT ( 72 ) at 30 kg weight compared to TYTAN.
blocks.zh: 我们按照 Section 3.3.3 中的方法，将运输能耗比（CoT）分解为电子系统能耗比（CoE）、驱动器能耗比（CoD）和机动运动能耗比（CoL）。Table 4 总结了各项占比贡献。对于 ANYMAL D，运输能耗比（CoT）降至 1 . 27（相比之下 ANYMAL C 为 1 . 86）；TYTAN 则达到 0 . 97。在这两个平台上，只有不到一半的能量归因于 CoL。在与 TYTAN 相当的 30 kg 体重下，生物犬在仅有一半 CoT（72）的情况下达到了类似的能量分布。

blocks.en: 4.2.4 Dynamic-limit demonstrations Figure 11 shows three policies trained in fitted simulation and deployed zero-shot. On ANYMAL, we demonstrate two-legged balancing (orientation tracking) and running. In these running trials, simulation attained ≈ 4 m s−1 ; hardware peaked near 3 m s−1 , limited by battery current (32 A threshold; Figure 12). On MINIMAL (4 kg), the policy climbs standard 18 cm stairs continuously (20 steps in 46 s).
blocks.zh:
4.2.4 动态极限演示
Figure 11 展示了在拟合仿真中训练并进行零样本迁移部署的三种策略。在 ANYMAL 上，我们展示了双足平衡（姿态朝向跟踪）和奔跑。在这些奔跑试验中，仿真速度达到了 ≈ 4 m s−1；硬件实物峰值速度接近 3 m s−1，受限于电池电流（32 A 阈值；Figure 12）。在 MINIMAL（4 kg）上，该策略能够连续攀爬标准 18 cm 楼梯（46 s 内攀爬 20 阶）。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论

blocks.en: Inner loop as near–unit torque source. The electrical inner loop tracks torque at high bandwidth (measured ≈ 346 Hz), so within the policy’s frequency range it can be treated as a near–unit-gain source (Section 4.1.1). With more advanced control, bandwidths up to ∼ 3 . 5 kHz are feasible ( 73 ).
blocks.zh: 内环作为近似单位增益力矩源。电气内环以高带宽（实测约为 ≈ 346 Hz）跟踪力矩，因此在策略的有效频率范围内，它可以被视为一个近似单位增益源（Section 4.1.1）。采用更先进的控制方法，高达 ∼ 3 . 5 kHz 的带宽也是可行的（73）。

blocks.en: Physicality of fitted parameters and virtual inertia. On a single drive, PACE recovers output inertias that match analytic expectations, and the drive behaves closely like a second–order LTI system. Because the mechanical bandwidth falls in the excitation range, Ia and d can be reliably identified and directly relate to the dynamics shaped by the PD gains (cf. Section 2.1). When firmware compensations are enabled, we observe an additive, load–independent virtual inertia that shifts the effective
blocks.zh: 拟合参数的物理真实性与虚拟惯量。在单驱动器上，PACE 辨识出的输出转动惯量符合解析预期，且驱动器的表现非常接近二阶 LTI 系统。由于机械带宽落在激励频率范围内，Ia 和 d 能够被可靠辨识，并直接与由 PD 增益塑造的动力学相关联（参见 Section 2.1）。当启用固件补偿时，我们观察到一种附加的、与负载无关的虚拟惯量改变了有效

blocks.en: dynamics (Section 4.1.1); identification and deployment should therefore use identical firmware modes.
blocks.zh: 动力学（Section 4.1.1）；因此，辨识与部署应当使用完全相同的固件模式。

blocks.en: Interpreting Ia and d . Across abstraction levels, the fitted armature term Ia aggregates rotor inertia, compensation effects, and inaccuracies in link and load modeling, while the fitted damping term d captures contributions from the motor, gearbox, and compensations. Both scale with the ratio ki/ki, real, and are handled end–to–end by PACE. The unexpectedly larger full-robot Ia (about fourfold relative to the single-drive baseline) is consistent with three effects: (i) underestimation of link inertia in CAD, particularly in the thigh, (ii) additional apparent inertia introduced by compensation, and (iii) rotor inertia. A diagnostic single-legsegment analysis confirms this explanation (Appendix C), but it is not central to our contribution.
blocks.zh: 对 Ia 和 d 的解释。跨越不同的抽象层级，拟合出的电枢项 Ia 综合汇集了转子惯量、补偿效应以及连杆与负载建模中的不准确性；而拟合出的阻尼项 d 则捕捉了来自电机、减速箱和补偿环节的贡献。两者均按比例 ki/ki, real 缩放，并由 PACE 进行端到端处理。整机 Ia 出人意料地偏大（相对于单驱动器基线约为四倍），这与三种效应相一致：(i) CAD 中对连杆惯量的低估，尤其是大腿部分；(ii) 补偿引入的额外视在惯量；以及 (iii) 转子惯量。单腿节的诊断性分析证实了这一解释（Appendix C），但这并非我们贡献的核心。

blocks.en: Generalization across gains and trajectories. Fitted simulators reproduce in–air trajectories at unseen PD gains and for unseen trajectories with higher fidelity than the actuator–network baseline, indicating a consistent physical model rather than an overfit function approximator (cf. Figure 5d, Figure 10 and Figure 20).
blocks.zh: 跨增益与跨轨迹的泛化能力。拟合后的仿真器在未见过的 PD 增益以及未见过的轨迹下复现空中轨迹的保真度均高于执行器网络基线，这表明它是一个自洽的物理模型，而非过拟合的函数逼近器（参见 Figure 5d、Figure 10 和 Figure 20）。

blocks.en: In–air data suffices for contact tasks. Identifying joint–space dynamics (Section 2.2) is sufficient for zero–shot locomotion.
blocks.zh: 空中数据足以支撑接触任务。辨识关节空间动力学（Section 2.2）就足以实现零样本迁移的机动行走。

blocks.en: Zero–model failure and the role of speed. Policies trained without actuator models can fail even at low speeds (Section 4.2); covering the resulting gap would require heavy dynamics randomization, whose scope grows rapidly with step frequency (Figure 19). Thus, achievable speed (step frequency) is a sensitive proxy for the reality gap.
blocks.zh: 无模型失败与速度的作用。在没有执行器模型的情况下训练的策略即使在低速下也可能会失败（Section 4.2）；要弥合由此产生的差距，将需要进行大量的动力学随机化，且其随机化范围随着步频的增加而急剧扩大（Figure 19）。因此，可实现的速度（步频）是衡量现实差距的一个敏感代理指标。

blocks.en: Sim2real tracking and dynamic behaviors. Open–loop base–velocity replays match between real and simulation (Figure 6), and PACE is competitive with the actuator network on ANYMAL (Figure 7). The same modeling enabled two–leg balancing and high–speed running up to the platform’s electrical limit (Section 4.2.4) and continuous stair-climbing on MINIMAL and the fastest ANYMAL ever reportedly ran. The 3 m s−1 ceiling on ANYMAL is set by battery current limits (32 A, Figure 12). Notably, PACE uses only ∼ 20 s of encoder–only in–air data per robot, versus minutes of torque–instrumented data for actuator networks—broadening applicability to systems without torque sensors.
blocks.zh: Sim2real 跟踪与动态行为。开环机体速度重演在真实系统与仿真之间高度吻合（Figure 6），且 PACE 在 ANYMAL 上与执行器网络相比极具竞争力（Figure 7）。同样的建模方法使机器人能够实现双足平衡、达到平台电气极限的高速奔跑（Section 4.2.4）、在 MINIMAL 上实现连续爬楼梯，并创下了据报道有史以来最快的 ANYMAL 奔跑纪录。ANYMAL 上 3 m s−1 的速度上限是由电池电流限制决定的（32 A，Figure 12）。值得注意的是，PACE 每台机器人仅使用约 ∼ 20 s 仅含编码器的空中数据，而执行器网络则需要数分钟带有力矩传感器测量的数据——这大大拓宽了其在无力矩传感器系统上的适用性。

blocks.en: Energy shaping and straight–leg gaits. With compensation and ki drift folded into d , the energy reward (Section 2.3.3) penalizes dissipations that correlate with track–side CoT reductions (Table 4). Precise simulator fitting through parameter fitting eliminates the need for dynamics randomization, enabling ANYMAL to adopt straighter–knee gaits. This reduces the total CoT by ∼ 32 % and halving locomotion losses. Despite TYTAN’s efficient drives and low leg inertia, its inability to fully straighten the knee keeps its locomotion cost only ∼ 11 % lower than ANYMAL’s in this
blocks.zh: 能量整形与直腿步态。将补偿与 ki 漂移折算入 d 后，能量奖励函数（Section 2.3.3）惩罚了与跑道实测 CoT 降低相关的耗散（Table 4）。通过参数拟合实现的精确仿真器拟合消除了对动力学随机化的需求，使 ANYMAL 能够采用膝关节更伸直的步态。这使总 CoT 降低了约 ∼ 32 %，并将机动运动损失减半。尽管 TYTAN 拥有高效的驱动器和较低的腿部惯量，但其无法完全伸直膝关节，使得在此工况下其机动能耗仅比 ANYMAL 低约 ∼ 11 %，

blocks.en: regime, underscoring the energetic importance of full knee extension on flat terrain (Table 4.2.3).
blocks.zh: 这一工况凸显了在平坦地形上膝关节完全伸展在能效方面的重要性（Table 4.2.3）。

blocks.en: Where the watts go. For both ANYMAL and TYTAN, less than half of the energy budget is spent on locomotion itself; electronics and inverter switching account for the remainder. Algorithmic efficiency alone cannot close the full CoT gap to biology. We need to build robots based on more efficient sensors, computers, and power electronics.
blocks.zh: 功耗去向分析。对于 ANYMAL 和 TYTAN 而言，全部能耗预算中用于机动运动本身的均不足一半；其余能耗则由电子系统和逆变器开关损耗所占据。单靠算法效率无法完全弥合与生物系统之间的 CoT 差距。我们需要基于更高效的传感器、计算机和电力电子设备来构建机器人。

blocks.en: Generalization across robots. The same parameterization { I a, d , τ f , ˜ q b, Td} transfers from open (TYTAN, MINIMAL) to closed (ANYMAL) platforms—and beyond—suggesting a broadly useful basis.
blocks.zh: 跨机器人的泛化能力。相同的参数化表征 { I a, d , τ f , ˜ q b, Td} 能够从开放平台（TYTAN、MINIMAL）迁移至封闭平台（ANYMAL）——甚至拓展至更多系统——这表明其构成了一个具有广泛实用性的基石。

blocks.en: Future extensions.
blocks.zh: 未来扩展方向。

blocks.en: - Hybrid CMA–ES with local gradient refinements in differentiable physics.
blocks.zh: - 结合可微物理中局部梯度细化的混合 CMA–ES。

blocks.en: - Contact–parameter refinement when foot–force sensing or plates are available.
blocks.zh: - 在具备足端力传感或测力板时进行接触参数细化。

blocks.en: - Lightweight online adaptation (global scale on {Ia, d} ) to track wear/temperature over time ( 32 ).
blocks.zh: - 轻量级在线自适应（对 {Ia, d} 进行全局缩放），用于跟踪随时间推移的磨损/温度变化 ( 32 )。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented Precise Adaptation through Continuous Evolution (PACE) , an alignment of joint-space dynamics that enables zero-shot sim2real locomotion without dynamics randomization. The key idea is to fit a parameterization—perjoint armature, viscous damping, Coulomb friction, joint bias, and a global delay—directly using ∼ 20 s of in-air, encoder-only trajectories and massively parallel evolutionary search.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了基于持续进化的精确自适应方法（Precise Adaptation through Continuous Evolution，PACE），这是一种关节空间动力学对齐方法，无需动力学随机化即可实现零样本仿真到现实（sim2real）的运动迁移。其核心思想是直接利用约 20 s 的悬空、仅依赖编码器的运动轨迹，并通过大规模并行进化搜索来拟合一套参数化模型——包括各关节电枢惯量、黏性阻尼、库仑摩擦、关节偏置以及全局延迟。

blocks.en: Across three platforms (TYTAN, ANYMAL, MINIMAL), the fitted simulators reproduce in-air joint trajectories with near overlap and generalize across PD gains and trajectories; on ANYMAL they close the gap where URDF-only models fail and match actuator-network fidelity while requiring less data and no torque sensors. The fitted dynamics translates to the ground: blind locomotion policies train in fitted simulation and deploy zero-shot, yielding accurate basevelocity tracking and endurance improvements on a 400 m track (e.g., ANYMAL D: CoT 1 . 27 and 4 . 12 km; TYTAN: CoT 0 . 97 and 6 . 10 km). Dynamic-limit demonstrations (twolegged balance, ∼ 3 m / s running bounded by a 32 A battery limit, and stair climbing on a 4 kg robot) further indicate that residual constraints are hardware–power and sensing limited rather than model limited.
blocks.zh: 在三个平台（TYTAN、ANYmal、MINIMAL）上，拟合后的仿真器复现了几乎完全重合的空中关节轨迹，并在不同的 PD 增益和运动轨迹间展现出良好的泛化能力；在 ANYmal 上，它们弥合了仅依靠 URDF 模型时失效的差距，在所需数据更少且无需扭矩传感器的情况下，达到了执行器网络的保真度。拟合的动力学特性顺利迁移到了地面场景：在拟合仿真中训练的盲视运动策略实现了零样本部署，在 400 m 跑道上展现出精确的机身速度跟踪性能与更强的续航表现（例如，ANYmal D：CoT 为 1 . 27 且续航达 4 . 12 km；TYTAN：CoT 为 0 . 97 且续航达 6 . 10 km）。极限动态演示（双足平衡、受 32 A 电池电流限制约 3 m / s 的奔跑，以及 4 kg 机器人攀爬楼梯）进一步表明，残余约束主要源于硬件功率与传感限制，而非模型本身的限制。

blocks.en: The approach is dataand compute-efficient (20 s trajectories, single-GPU, 10 – 24 h per robot with N = 4096 environments) and applies to both open and closed platforms, provided firmware compensation modes and filters are consistent between identification and deployment. Current limitations include finite excitation bandwidth on suspended setups and temperature/aging dependencies that shift effective parameters. Our approach fails if any of the
blocks.zh: 该方法具备较高的数据与计算效率（20 s 轨迹，单 GPU，在 N = 4096 个环境中每台机器人耗时 10 – 24 h），且只要系统辨识与部署之间的固件补偿模式及滤波器保持一致，便同时适用于开放和封闭平台。当前的局限性包括悬挂装置上的激励带宽有限，以及会导致有效参数发生漂移的温度与老化依赖性。若出现以下情况，我们的方法将会失效：

blocks.en: assumptions from Section 2.4 are violated, which fully online and model-free approaches might be able to catch.
blocks.zh: 第 2.4 节中的假设被违反；而完全在线且无模型的方法或许能够应对这些情况。

blocks.en: Future work will focus on (i) accurately identifying electrical constraints—bus-voltage (Appendix A) and current limits (Section 12), and inverter switching behavior—and embedding them into the fit, and (ii) explicitly modeling compliance (joint/foot stiffness, link flexibilities, series elasticity) within the optimization. Together, these additions should enable higher step-frequency gaits that deliberately exploit hardware dynamics rather than fight them. As simulators expose richer effects, we will also extend the parameterization beyond acceleration to include higher-order motion terms—jerk... q , snap q(4) , crackle q(5) , and pop q(6) —to better capture bandwidth limits, electro-magnetic effects, mitigate wear, and shape smooth, high-frequency locomotion.
blocks.zh: 未来的工作将侧重于：(i) 精确辨识电气约束——母线电压（附录 A）、电流限制（第 12 节）以及逆变器开关行为——并将其嵌入拟合流程中；(ii) 在优化过程中对柔顺性（关节/足端刚度、连杆柔性、串联弹性）进行显式建模。这两项补充相结合，有望实现主动利用硬件动力学特性而非与其对抗的更高步频步态。随着仿真器能够呈现更丰富的物理效应，我们还将把参数化扩展至加速度之外的高阶运动项——加加速度（jerk）... q、加加加速度（snap）q(4)、crackle q(5) 以及 pop q(6)——以更好地捕捉带宽限制与电磁效应，减轻磨损，并塑造平滑的高频运动。

blocks.en: Takeaway. A small, physically meaningful parameter set (4 n +1), identified from in-air experiments using jointencoders, is sufficient to eliminate dynamics randomization for blind quadrupedal locomotion and to translate simulation capabilities to hardware in a single shot.
blocks.zh: 核心结论：仅利用关节编码器通过悬空实验辨识出的一组具有明确物理意义的精简参数集（4 n +1），就足以在盲视四足运动中消除动力学随机化，并实现从仿真能力到真实硬件的一次性无缝迁移。

blocks.en: Taking the available phase voltage to be limited by the DC–bus (conservatively U max ≈ U bus = 48 V, up to modulation factors), our drive yields f∞ ≈ 310 Hz. Hence, even at the voltage limit the current loop can, in principle, exceed the policy Nyquist of 25 Hz.

blocks.en: At nonzero electrical speed ωe , the back–EMF eq = ωeλ consumes part of the voltage headroom:

As ωe increases (or during field–weakening), the effective current (torque) bandwidth reduces because U max − eq shrinks. In practice, the achievable closed–loop bandwidth is also bounded to a fraction of the PWM carrier frequency and by inverter dead times and delays.
blocks.zh: 随着 ωe 的增大（或在弱磁控制过程中），由于 U max − eq 减小，有效电流（扭矩）带宽会随之降低。在实际应用中，可实现的闭环带宽还会受到 PWM 载波频率的一定比例以及逆变器死区时间和延迟的限制。

blocks.en: Implication. For our experiments—low to moderate speeds and ≤ 25 Hz policy content—the inner loop behaves as a near–unit–gain motor torque source; high–speed limits are then dominated by voltage/current headroom (e.g., battery current limiting), not by inner–loop dynamics.
blocks.zh: 工程意义：对于我们的实验而言——处于中低速范围且策略频率成分 ≤ 25 Hz——内环表现为一个接近单位增益的电机扭矩源；高速极限则由电压/电流裕量（如电池电流限制）主导，而非受限于内环动力学特性。

blocks.en: To analyze the difference between drive-specific in-air inertia and contact-induced inertia, we apply d’Alembert’s principle of virtual displacements. We consider two scenarios: (i) vertical motion of the robot’s base and legs, and (ii) horizontal motion parallel to the ground, both starting from the nominal agile stance . In both cases, we analyze the dynamics in the robot’s x – z plane.

blocks.en: For tractability, we neglect leg masses and account only for the base mass and link inertias. We further assume equal link lengths of 0 . 3 m for the thigh and shank and no gravity.

blocks.en: To analyze the discrepancy between single-drive and fullrobot inertia estimates, we performed a study on a legsegment of TYTAN. The KFE was disconnected to minimize friction, allowing the thigh or shank to swing freely. This setup permits direct estimation of link inertias from free oscillations, which we then compare against CAD-derived values and the PACE fit.
blocks.zh: 为了分析单驱动器与整机机器人惯量估计值之间的差异，我们在 TYTAN 的腿部分段上进行了一项研究。断开 KFE 关节以最大程度减小摩擦，使大腿或小腿能够自由摆动。该实验设置允许直接通过自由振荡来估计连杆惯量，随后我们将估计结果与 CAD 衍生值以及 PACE 拟合值进行对比。
